Not the full directory

The general list is hentai sites, 64 entries that mix streaming, manga and 3D. Most of those cards say only "official hentai site," and the category page refuses to guess what they play.

That is also why this is not a second copy of the category, which remains the directory. This is a 2026 reading order for the labeled names.

"New," used in the title, means the formats people are opening from that current list: a streaming site, a premium studio, manga hosts, an artist community, and rendered 3D. It does not mean each domain was registered this year.

If the search was "new" because 3D renders feel newer than scanned manga, PorCore is the name the hentai page itself marks as 3D. The other 3D names are a list of titles, not a list of reviews.

How to read a card

A free tag, a premium tag, and a one-line format are the whole public note until a review exists. Aggressive redirects are one of the things the hentai category says it watches, and an unlabeled card is where that risk hides.

Open the category, read the one line, and stop if the line does not say what the site is. Guessing a catalogue is how a directory invents a review.

This page also does not link to the platforms. The category cards carry the visit links, and a blog post is the wrong place to add another outbound hop.

Adults only. Anything involving minors is outside what this directory is for, and a hentai label is not a waiver of that.

When a real review exists, the score will sit on the card. Until then, "not yet reviewed" is the honest status for Hanime, Hentaied, the manga hosts, Gelbooru, Pixiv, and PorCore.
